statement: NVIDIA will invest $5 billion in Intel common stock at $23.28 per share, with Intel building custom x86 CPUs featuring NVLink for NVIDIA's AI platforms (deal terms dated 2025-09-18).
why: The partnership ties Intel CPUs and manufacturing into NVIDIA's AI infrastructure, supporting demand for Intel's data-center and foundry role.

impact.mechanism: NVLink-enabled custom x86 CPUs deepen Intel's role in NVIDIA AI platforms, a structural design-win channel.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA will invest $5 billion in Intel common stock at $23.28 per share

confidence.basis: Secondary newsroom summary; core deal terms carry a 2025-09-18 primary date outside the recent window.
